purpose: Reproducible consolidation and bounded sensitivity study, not a new untouched holdout or production model
source: Retained nflverse schedules games.csv, CC BY 4.0, nflverse / Lee Sharpe
cohort: All paired non-tied games with valid Elo and no-vig closing moneylines; no confidence, side, profit or matchup selection
training: Each target season uses only the preceding two seasons; underlying Elo uses existing fitBeforeSeason and day-frozen updates

models.market: Unchanged raw de-vigged retrospective closing reference
models.constrainedOffset: Same formula; beta fit on two preceding seasons with sum log loss + 20*beta^2/2, constrained to [0,1], no intercept or market recalibration
models.marketCalibration: Existing fitPriorLogistic residual=false, slope prior1 penalty20, intercept prior0 penalty2
models.calibratedResidual: Existing fitPriorLogistic residual=true, residual prior0 penalty20; retained diagnostic control from earlier research

primary: Paired mean log-loss gain versus unchanged raw market; positive is improvement
secondary: Brier, directional counts with exact 0.5 abstentions, per-season results
uncertainty: 10000 common season-week block bootstrap draws, resampling weeks within each season; centered maximum absolute deviation simultaneous 95% log-loss intervals across all five non-market comparisons. Descriptive development uncertainty, not valid post-selection certification across past BETQ searches
integrity: Hash raw source and protocol; retain fits, exclusions and all game predictions; perturb target/future outcomes to verify fitted parameters and target opening-day probabilities unchanged; no network or implicit source download
limitations: All evaluation seasons have been repeatedly examined; this is development research, not fresh confirmatory evidence
Historical sources may have revisions; no proof of historical source availability
Closing quotes have no verified observation times or execution; later information makes this an unequal-time retrospective benchmark
Bootstrap intervals condition on retained forecasts and do not model coefficient-estimation uncertainty or all prior search multiplicity
No 2026 prospective outcomes enter fitting or scoring
